1	# Build - notes
2	
3	A redesign of a design's Build page (`/f/:folder/d/:design/build`): today
4	`server/views/_build.eta`, fed by `buildView()` in `server/main.js`, with
5	stories made by templates in `server/backlog.js` (`storyMarkdown`,
6	`incrementStory`, `layoutsStory`) from `increment.js`'s diff. The route
7	carries `"from": "@app/server/views/_build"`. The fake design being built
8	is "Loan offers" in borrower-portal (Offers, Compare offers, Accept an
9	offer, plus "Across the design").
10	
11	Pages: Build (`build/page`, its list `build/_pages`); a page's story
12	(`/build/stories/:group`: `build/story`, `_stories`, `_story`,
13	`_story-edit`, the `_rewrite` modal); a build session
14	(`/sessions/:session`: `build/session`, its check `_check`, one screen
15	`_shot`, `_tally`, `_open-app`, what's next `_next`, and for the app build
16	and the shell's layouts what the build did, `_result`; `_chat`,
17	`_transcript`, `_entry`, `_composer` are a stand-in for the design page's
18	chat). States: typical, split and writing, not approved, building, no app,
19	all built; each has a page's build session (typical: mid-build, one
20	differs, two not built; building: the agent working, one doesn't render,
21	the app stopped; no app: the app stopped; all built: done). Then three on
22	the borrower-portal's App shell: app build (waiting for approval), app
23	doesn't start (with what it printed), layouts built (done, the app
24	running). Events: `story-written`, `check-done`.
25	
26	## What was wrong with it
27	
28	- The story was raw Markdown in a read-only textarea behind "Copy as story".
29	- Stories were written for the server: route patterns, `POST … updates the
30	  record at …`, file paths; each card listed routes and "the design's view".
31	- Blockers (no app, not approved, behind main, building) were stacked cards.
32	- Old layout and ds/v1.
33	- Not only what differs from the app: `increment.js` compares with the same
34	  design on main, so a redesign of an app

1	# Design Workspace - notes
2	
3	A redesign of Prelude's design page (`/f/:folder/d/:design`, its sessions and
4	the pop-out window): today `server/views/_session.eta`, `_design.eta`,
5	`_branch.eta`, `_entry.eta`, `_status.eta`, `_composer.eta`, `_window.eta`.
6	It renders in the shell's `workspace` and `window` layouts. The routes carry
7	`"from": "@app/server/views/…"`, so the build ports it back.
8	
9	Pages: Design page, with drawers (About the design, Rules, Open
10	questions) and modals (an image, Mark up, Turn on dictation); Pop-out
11	window. The fake project is a lender's borrower portal, so sizes (phone,
12	tablet) and a second client (its mobile app) mean something. States:
13	typical, pages differ, doesn't render, building, new design, update
14	clashed, popped out, new session.
15	
16	All seven items of the first review are now designed or settled (item 4,
17	the record picker, was dropped).
18	
19	## Decisions
20	
21	- **Scope: 1-3 of the review, plus the pop-out** (the person, 2026-10-17):
22	  the header, the design bar, and check results that lead somewhere.
23	- **A one-line header.** Crumbs and title, then the branch as one button
24	  with pills for what to act on (check, behind main, a clash). It opens a
25	  drawer (`/about`) with the branch in full and its actions, what the design
26	  uses, and what the agent can read. An update that clashed also shows as a
27	  notice above the work, since it holds the branch.
28	- **The chat owns its toolbar**: sessions menu, Show Agent/Tools, New
29	  session. A build session says so in a notice at the top of the chat.
30	- **The design bar reads "what am I looking at", then "how"**: Design/App,
31	  page (Refresh and Open in browser moved into its menu, since they act on
32	  the page), state, Send event, Reset data; then size, client, Pop out.

**Removed from the views:**

A build's check now lives on its build session's page. **The app still has these in `server/views/_design-bar.eta`**, but no data the design page gets triggers them, and building this design removes them.
- **Chat:** the "This session builds …" notice, and the Build pill in the sessions menu.
- **Transcript:** the "Next:" entry after a build turn.

The header's Build button stays, since it goes to the Build page rather than a build session.

**States:**
- I took `mode` and `app` out of every state.
- `04-building` is now `04-agent-working`: a design session where the agent is part-way through a turn, with a tool error, a reply still being written and one message waiting to send.
